correctness.rationale: For leaf-to-leaf distances ell_i+ell_j, a zero-mass Arens–Eells molecule has exact norm Σ ell_i|c_i|, proved both by transport along the star and signed one-Lipschitz potentials; free Banach space gives a universal lower-bound test for nonlinear target-dependent extension. Represent any center by affine weights summing one. Symmetrization under S_m reduces optimal center to m coefficients a and long coefficient 1−ma without worsening maximum. Exact center radius is max{1,F(a),G(a)} with F=|1−a|+(m−1)|a|+R|1−ma|, G=m(1+1/R)|a|. For a<0 F exceeds F(0); for a≥1/m F and G nondecrease; on [0,1/m] F=1+R+(m−2−mR)a decreases, G increases. Their unique intersection is inside iff R≤m/(m−2), giving a=R(R+1)/(mR²+2R+m) and value m(R+1)²/(mR²+2R+m), otherwise a=1/m and 2−2/m. Transition continuous, long-leaf weight vanishes thereafter; m≥3,R≥1 boundaries and symmetric uniqueness checked. Independent exact-rational minimax tests 860 assertions confirm finite choices, not general proof.
